# Client-oracle fixtures

Synthetic, immutable byte fixtures transcribed from the recovered Korean P5099
client reader layouts. They are not generated by `p5099-core` and contain no
captured account or authentication data. They are the primary evidence that
the independent reader is not merely agreeing with the production writer.

- `game_result_idb_synthetic.hex` (`sub_726CC0`, `sub_71BF00`, `sub_71BAD0`):
  one red-team human then one blue-team DNF AI, then the five-byte terminal
  marker. The human record is 208 bytes, matching reader `0x007115C0` with its
  four lists empty.
- `game_next_stage_idb.hex` (`sub_72FC40`): game type four, both terminal
  dwords zero.
